The main takeaway from our work is that

the photo injector can provide electron beams with a normalized RMS emittance as small as 1 μm, for all charge levels, if the electron beam is extracted from the photocathode with an energy of 40 MeV and a beam current of about 1 A.
the photo injector performance can be optimized in such a way that a high brightness of the electron beam is maintained for a wide range and a large range of bunch charges.
the photo injector performance can be improved by optimizing the laser pulse shape, the electron beam energy, and the laser beam position.
